paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (as plotted on y-axis)
notes: Microwave light-shining-through-wall experiment (CROWS) at CERN. Reports both ALP (g=4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at 7.2 ueV) and hidden sector photon (chi=4.1e-9 at 10.8 ueV) limits. DarkPhoton (HSP) result selected per hint and abstract emphasis on previously unexplored region. Only a single representative point given in text; full exclusion curve is in Fig. 14 but not tabulated numerically.
